codeReview.summary: Clean, well-structured rewrite of buildPlanReviewPrompt() from markdown table output to JSON annotation output. All feature requirements met: 6 reviewer agents dispatched, annotated JSON with review.findings[] per step and openQuestions[] at top level, draft-authored fields explicitly protected (11 fields listed), markdown table format removed, planReviewValidationCriteria updated, plan workflow step 2 criteria/hint updated. 37 new tests with thorough coverage including JSON validity parsing, schema field checks, negative assertions on old format. Legacy tests in prompts.test.ts updated correctly. ANNOTATED_JSON_EXAMPLE extracted as a constant for testability — good pattern.

issues.description: The prompt makes 'options' a required field on openQuestions ('Each openQuestion must have: question, raisedBy, options'), but the canonical schema in .factory/library/json-plan-migration.md defines 'options?: string[]' as optional. This strictness mismatch could cause workers to hallucinate options when none are natural. Consider aligning with the canonical schema by saying 'options (array of choices, if applicable)' or updating the migration guide to make options required.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The ANNOTATED_JSON_EXAMPLE constant is module-private (not exported). This is fine for now since tests verify the prompt string content. However, if future features (e.g., consolidation step, JSON schema validation) need to reference the canonical annotated structure, it may need to be exported or moved to a shared types/schema file.
